assumptions: Forward returns use next-open to exit-close and prefer qfq prices when present.
If true market value is absent, size neutralization falls back to a coarse basket of log(amount), log(vol) and log(price) exposures.
Industry neutralization remains a documented hook only because current cache has no true industry column.
Large-order factor is a placeholder based on daily amount shock and low drift, not tick data.
Entry/exit tradability use limit-up buy and limit-down sell close-lock proxies, not auction or queue-depth fill data.
Production scoring emphasizes 3d/5d horizons because 1d next-open to close is structurally more cost-dominated under the current friction model.
todos: Add true industry classification and market value exposures.
Replace limit-up/down close-lock proxies with session-level auction and queue data when available.
Replace large-order placeholder with order-flow or tick features.
Add factor selection policy beyond noise rejection.

factor_descriptions.relative_strength_proxy: Close relative to its 10-day mean; non-lagged strength proxy.
factor_descriptions.turnover_stability_proxy: Negative volatility of log volume; turnover stability proxy.
factor_descriptions.amplitude_deviation: Daily range relative to recent range regime.
factor_descriptions.liquidity_shock_proxy: Abnormal amount per unit range; coarse liquidity shock.
factor_descriptions.large_order_proxy_placeholder: Placeholder for block flow using amount shock and low directional drift.
factor_descriptions.intraday_mean_reversion_proxy: Close-open location within daily range, signed for intraday fade.
factor_descriptions.chip_cost_support: Price relative to average chip cost; lower versus cost gets higher score.
factor_descriptions.winner_rate_contra: Contrarian chip crowding proxy from winner rate.
factor_descriptions.moneyflow_large_strength: Large-order net inflow relative to turnover; real moneyflow strength proxy.
factor_descriptions.moneyflow_retail_contra: Retail-dominant net outflow as a contrarian participation proxy.
factor_descriptions.moneyflow_flow_accel: Acceleration of large-order net flow versus its short baseline.
factor_descriptions.turnover_stability_x_short_term_reversal: Interaction of stable turnover regime and short-term reversal.
factor_descriptions.intraday_mean_reversion_x_amplitude_devi: Interaction of intraday fade signal and unusual range regime.
factor_descriptions.winner_rate_contra_x_chip_cost_support: Interaction of contrarian chip crowding and chip-cost support.
factor_descriptions.volume_surge_x_liquidity_shock: Interaction of abnormal volume expansion and liquidity shock.
factor_descriptions.moneyflow_large_strength_x_turnover_stab: Interaction of large-order net inflow and stable turnover regime.
factor_descriptions.moneyflow_retail_contra_x_short_term_rev: Interaction of retail contrarian flow and short-term reversal.

factor_specs.roe_stability: ROE stability over multiple reporting periods (PIT required).
factor_specs.gross_margin_trend: Gross margin improvement trend within industry peers.
factor_specs.ar_turnover_quality: Accounts receivable turnover quality / deterioration signal.
factor_specs.cashflow_coverage: Cash flow coverage of earnings and liabilities.
factor_specs.forward_pe_value: Forward PE or valuation relative to own growth and peers.
factor_specs.dividend_yield_value: Dividend yield as value support signal.

implemented_this_step: Connected long-term runner to the real enriched daily-basic snapshot.
Built an investable research base filtered by current universe/tradability flags.
Added value-style proxy ranking using PE/PB/dividend/size coverage already on disk.
Added industry-relative z-score standardization and defensive value blending on proxy factors.
current_proxy_limits: No PIT financial panel yet, so ROE/cashflow/growth factors remain unimplemented.
Industry-relative z-scoring now works on proxy factors, but it still is not a PIT fundamental model.
Current candidate ranking is usable as a research shortlist, not a production long-term model.
next_steps: Add long-horizon forward return construction for 20/40/60 trading days.
Add regime split validation for 2015-2016, 2018, and 2022-2024.
Add true accounting-quality / cashflow / leverage factors once PIT panels are connected.
